title: Governance: trusted gate runner and evidence verification (v2)
_revision: v2 closes review blockers B1-B3. Draft only: not registered, not approved. Must run in the isolated worktree gov-trusted-gate-evidence (own .claude copy and ledger), never in the AUTHZ05 or PR-SEC-01 checkouts. The human fills baseline_manifest.path and baseline_manifest.sha256 from the real M0 before approval; approval binds these exact bytes and any later edit voids it. Design reference: 2026-11-24-trusted-gate-evidence-design-v2.md.

baseline_manifest.format: lines of '<sha256 lowercase hex>  <relative path with />' sorted by ordinal path; H-set excludes orchestration/runs/**, orchestration/approvals/**, orchestration/ACTIVE_RUN, orchestration/hook-debug.log, reports/**, worktrees/**

human_authored_inputs: .claude/orchestration/trusted-interpreters.json (created by the human in the worktree BEFORE M0 is captured; agents may not write it; schema {schema:1, interpreters:[{path, sha256}]})
required_independent_verification: A reviewer who is not the author recomputes the final manifest MF, diffs it against M0, the Change Set and allowed_paths, reads every E-set change, reruns the Node tests in a clean shell and the adversarial cases in a temp tree, and records an APPROVABLE verdict before close. close --force is not an acceptance path.

planned_tasks.title: ledger-core.mjs: manifest enumeration and hashing (H-set and E-set rules), git-visible tree digest, strict schema-1 evidence validator

run-gate.mjs: gate-ID-only; approved-run precondition; argv-only spawn; scrubbed env; fresh mkdtemp; interpreter allowlist from trusted-interpreters.json; junit recount; manifest-scope step; conditional harness env; schema-1 evidence bound to ledger run, gate and Change Set
gates.json: runner blocks for every CONFIGURED and EXECUTABLE autonomous gate; two-step G-SCOPE; G-BE-FULL conditional harness block; BLOCKED gates unchanged
Cross-check Node manifest vs human PowerShell output on a fixture tree; adversarial cases in an isolated temp tree

ledger.mjs: verifier in done() (newest runner entry per gate, strict validator, ledger_run, change_set_sha256, tree and file hashes, 12 hour bound), latest includes E-set mtimes, computeRisk raises .claude/ files to HIGH, status shows trust state. LAST code edit.

_order_note: planned_tasks is advisory (no code reads it). Registered without depends_on on purpose; procedure order is GE1, GE2, GE3, GE5, GE6, then GE4 last. No task is marked DONE until GE4 is live and the acceptance sweep runs; legacy evidence is never final acceptance.
_probe_note: Before any start, the human confirms hook-logged agent_stop events with agent_type exactly code-reviewer, security-auditor and test-engineer. If any is unknown or absent, stop; risk must not be downgraded.
